# The Command Line Options Reference

<DoxygenPage pluginConfig={pluginConfig}>

Options for controlling test output verbosity at run-time.

## Description {#details}

Options for controlling test output verbosity at run-time.

The µTest++ framework provides flexible command-line options to control the verbosity of test output, allowing users to tailor the level of detail to their specific requirements and workflow.

By default, the reporter presents detailed results only for failed test cases, while successful test cases are summarised in a single line, indicating the total number of passed and failed checks.


<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="console">

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">test 1</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">      Start  1: minimal-test</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1: Test command:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">/Users/ilg/MyProjects/micro-os-plus.github/xPacks/micro-test-plus-xpack.git/tests/build/native-cmake-sys-release/platform-bin/minimal-test</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">&quot;one&quot; &quot;two&quot; 1: Working Directory:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">/Users/ilg/MyProjects/micro-os-plus.github/xPacks/micro-test-plus-xpack.git/tests/build/native-cmake-sys-release/platform-bin</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1: Test timeout computed to be: 10000000</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1: Built with clang Apple LLVM 15.0.0 (clang-1500.0.40.1), with exceptions.</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1: • Minimal - test suite started</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1:   ✓ Check various conditions - test case passed (2 checks)</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">1:</span></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>



## Verbosity



To adjust the verbosity, the following command-line options are available:




<ul>
<li><code>--verbose</code> – display all expectations, regardless of outcome</li>
<li><code>--quiet</code> – display only the test suite totals</li>
<li><code>--silent</code> – suppress all output and return only the exit code</li>
</ul>




These options enable developers to focus on the information most relevant to their needs, whether that is comprehensive diagnostics during development or succinct summaries for automated builds.



The examples provided illustrate the output produced in each mode, demonstrating how µTest++ adapts its reporting to support professional and efficient testing workflows across all files and folders.



The source code for this test is located in the <code>tests/src/minimal-test.cpp</code> file.




### Verbose mode



In verbose mode, the µTest++ reporter provides detailed output for every expectation, irrespective of whether it passes or fails.




<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="console">

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">test 2</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">      Start  2: minimal-test --verbose</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">2: Test command:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">/Users/ilg/MyProjects/micro-os-plus.github/xPacks/micro-test-plus-xpack.git/tests/build/native-cmake-sys-release/platform-bin/minimal-test</span></CodeLine>

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">2: Test timeout computed to be: 10000000</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">2: Built with clang Apple LLVM 15.0.0 (clang-1500.0.40.1), with exceptions.</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">2:</span></CodeLine>

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">2:</span></CodeLine>

### Quiet mode



In quiet mode, the µTest++ reporter displays only the overall totals for the test suite.




<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="console">

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">test 3</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">      Start  3: minimal-test --quiet</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine></CodeLine>

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">&quot;one&quot; &quot;two&quot; &quot;--quiet&quot; 3: Working Directory:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">/Users/ilg/MyProjects/micro-os-plus.github/xPacks/micro-test-plus-xpack.git/tests/build/native-cmake-sys-release/platform-bin</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">3: Test timeout computed to be: 10000000</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">3:</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">3: ✓ Minimal - test suite passed (2 checks in 1 test case)</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight"> 3/12 Test  #3: minimal-test --quiet .............   Passed    0 sec</span></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>







### Silent mode



In silent mode, the µTest++ reporter suppresses all output, and the framework returns only the exit code.




<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="console">

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">test 4</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">      Start  4: minimal-test --silent</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine></CodeLine>
